comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. Sun Valley's Bald Mountain (way/1244099443, Sun Valley - Bald Mountain: the River Run, Seattle Ridge and Warm Springs sides) on its own map from sun-valley-v2 (the owner's rule of 2026-11-14: one map per ski area unless the areas are connected by lift or ski trail); sun-valley-v1 drew it with Dollar Mountain, whose entries moved to dollar-mountain.overrides.json. Dollar Mountain (way/1244098768) is a listed neighbour in resorts.json: its polygon lies 1.8 km east across the Big Wood River, joined to Bald Mountain by no lift or ski trail (the resort gives each mountain its own trail map at sunvalley.com/the-mountain/maps-guides, the Bald Mountain map draws the Mountain Rides bus between River Run Plaza, Ketchum and Dollar Mountain, and sunvalley.com/about/getting-here sends guests between the two on that free bus), and its 5 lifts and 30 runs in the Overpass window are left off (Bitterroot Bowl by the 250 m rule). No part of Bald Mountain is reached only by road or shuttle: River Run and Warm Springs are joined over the top by the lifts and runs. Every named run and lift checked again on 2026-11-14 against the resort's 2026-27 Bald Mountain trail map (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/maps-guides: 2627_SV_Baldy_Map_26-27_2580X1456.pdf, the file of 2026-10-01, rendered at six times its size and read tile by tile: Easiest, More Difficult, Most Difficult as one diamond, Experts Only as two, freestyle terrain as orange size badges) and its mountain report (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/mountain-report: 12 Bald Mountain lifts, 109 trails rated easy, moderate, difficult or most difficult and 4 terrain parks), the starting point being the combined map's check of 2026-11-10. OSM's easy, intermediate, advanced and expert are the map's green, blue, one diamond and two. Of the 100 named runs in OSM on Bald Mountain, the report rates most by the same name and the map labels the rest by section; all carry the resort's rating but seven runs, where the map and the report agree against OSM (ten ways): Numbers, Sunrise Bowl and The Glades (one diamond on the map and Most Difficult on the report; expert in OSM, their lines and outlines), Little Scorpion's outline (expert; its line is advanced already), Cut Off (one diamond, intermediate in OSM), Ridge (blue, easy in OSM) and the upper way of Olympic Ridge (green, intermediate in OSM). Fire Trail stays expert: two diamonds on the map and Most Difficult on the report, so the harder of the resort's and OSM's stands (lead's decision 2026-10-22). Names from the map: Sunset Strip (OSM Sunset Trip), Upper Flying Squirrel (OSM Flying Squirrel, the name of the chairlift beside it) and the Roundhouse Express Gondola (OSM Roundhouse Gondola, a stale name). Names that differ from the map only by a space, an abbreviation or a section stay as OSM has them: Undergraduate (UNDER GRADUATE), Sunnyside Bowl (SUNNY SIDE BOWL), Machine Road (MACHINE RD), Lower Picabo's (LOWER PICABO'S ST), and runs OSM maps whole where the map prints Upper, Mid and Lower sections (Cozy for Mid and Lower Cozy, Hemingway for Mid and Lower Hemingway, Picabo's Street for Upper and Mid Picabo's St, Limelight for Mid Limelight, Janss Pass, Can-Can and French Dip for their Upper sections), each already rated as its sections are. Runs OSM names that neither the map nor the report does stay with OSM's rating (International Ridge, International Trees, Upper and Lower Liftline and Mindbender). Parks: Bald Mountain's (Showtime Park, Saddle Up Park, College Hike Park and the Broadway Family Cross Course on the 2026-11-14 report) are not in OSM. Byron's Park is an easy run on both, not a park. Out of bounds: OSM's Sunrise Bowl (Out of Bounds), a line and an outline south of the in-bounds Sunrise Bowl beyond the boundary the map draws, has no backcountry tag and lies inside OSM's Bald Mountain polygon, so it is put out of bounds by override and drawn as Sunrise Bowl (out of bounds). The runs tagged backcountry in OSM (Little Scorpion's line and an unnamed way below it) lie inside the polygon and stay in bounds, as the map draws them inside the boundary. Lifts: all 12 of the report's Bald Mountain lifts are in OSM (Seattle Ridge, Mayday, Lookout, Christmas, Broadway, Roundhouse Express Gondola, River Run, Lookout Express, Frenchman's, Flying Squirrel, Challenger and the Kinderspielplatz conveyor). Hidden: four ski-jump pieces (two inruns and two landings, 35 to 71 m, freeride in OSM) 1.9 km north of Dollar Mountain's polygon by a historic lift station, just east of the box and inside the Overpass window, which are neither mountain's terrain and lie in no polygon that could be listed (hidden on dollar-mountain's map too). The Sun Valley Nordic Center's and the Wood River trails' cross-country ways (88 in the window) are left out by the pipeline's type rule, and three aerialway=yes station platforms at Dollar Mountain by the lift rule. OSM gaps (shipped as at Palisades Tahoe): 29 Turns, 42nd Street, Bear Den, Lookout Lane, Pioneer Bowl, Ridge S. Slopes, Sheep Camp, Tim's, Upper Warm Springs, Wolverton and the Kinderspielplatz learning slope are on the map or the report but not in OSM, nor are the parks above.

overrides.reason: Numbers is a single black diamond (Most Difficult) on Sun Valley's 2026-27 Bald Mountain trail map (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/maps-guides, 2627_SV_Baldy_Map_26-27_2580X1456.pdf) and Most Difficult on its mountain report (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/mountain-report); OSM rates the line expert. The resort's sources agree, so they win.
As way/1340804773: the outline of Numbers (area=yes, gladed), rated expert in OSM; one diamond on the 2026-27 Bald Mountain map and Most Difficult on the mountain report.

Sunrise Bowl is a single black diamond on Sun Valley's 2026-27 Bald Mountain trail map (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/maps-guides, 2627_SV_Baldy_Map_26-27_2580X1456.pdf) (inside the ski area boundary below Seattle Ridge) and Most Difficult on its mountain report (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/mountain-report); OSM rates the line expert. The resort's sources agree, so they win.

The Glades is a single black diamond on Sun Valley's 2026-27 Bald Mountain trail map (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/maps-guides, 2627_SV_Baldy_Map_26-27_2580X1456.pdf) (below Sunrise Bowl, with the glades symbol) and Most Difficult on its mountain report (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/mountain-report); OSM rates the line expert. The resort's sources agree, so they win.
As way/907060417: the outline of The Glades (area=yes, gladed), rated expert in OSM; one diamond on the 2026-27 Bald Mountain map and Most Difficult on the mountain report.

The outline of Little Scorpion (area=yes, gladed), rated expert in OSM; Sun Valley's 2026-27 Bald Mountain trail map (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/maps-guides, 2627_SV_Baldy_Map_26-27_2580X1456.pdf) gives it one diamond (with the glades symbol, above Lower Warm Springs) and its mountain report (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/mountain-report) rates it Most Difficult, as OSM rates its line (way/1282059985). The resort's sources agree, so they win.

Cut Off is a single black diamond on Sun Valley's 2026-27 Bald Mountain trail map (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/maps-guides, 2627_SV_Baldy_Map_26-27_2580X1456.pdf) (below Showtime Park, beside Upper Holiday) and Most Difficult on its mountain report (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/mountain-report); OSM rates it intermediate.

Ridge is blue (More Difficult) on Sun Valley's 2026-27 Bald Mountain trail map (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/maps-guides, 2627_SV_Baldy_Map_26-27_2580X1456.pdf) (along the Christmas lift) and More Difficult on its mountain report (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/mountain-report); OSM rates it easy.

The upper 303 m of Olympic Ridge, rated intermediate in OSM; Sun Valley's 2026-27 Bald Mountain trail map (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/maps-guides, 2627_SV_Baldy_Map_26-27_2580X1456.pdf) labels OLYMPIC RIDGE green (Easiest) and its mountain report (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/mountain-report) rates it Easiest, as OSM rates its lower way (way/1340804767). The resort's sources agree, so they win.

Misspelling: Sun Valley's 2026-27 Bald Mountain trail map (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/maps-guides, 2627_SV_Baldy_Map_26-27_2580X1456.pdf) labels this green run from Frenchman's to the Lookout Express base SUNSET STRIP, as its mountain report (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/mountain-report) lists it (Easiest, as OSM rates it); OSM has Sunset Trip.

Sun Valley's 2026-27 Bald Mountain trail map (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/maps-guides, 2627_SV_Baldy_Map_26-27_2580X1456.pdf) and its mountain report (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/mountain-report) name this blue run UPPER FLYING SQUIRREL (More Difficult, as OSM rates it), above Lower Flying Squirrel (way/1208395762); OSM calls it Flying Squirrel, the name of the Flying Squirrel chairlift beside it, so the map would label a run and a lift alike.

Sunrise Bowl's out-of-bounds side, the 1,578 m line that OpenStreetMap names Sunrise Bowl (Out of Bounds): Sun Valley's 2026-27 Bald Mountain trail map (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/maps-guides, 2627_SV_Baldy_Map_26-27_2580X1456.pdf) draws the ski area boundary between the in-bounds Sunrise Bowl and this slope south of it, and the resort's report lists no such run. OSM's Bald Mountain polygon reaches over it and it carries no backcountry tag, so the half rule would keep it in bounds; it is put out of bounds and named Sunrise Bowl, so the style labels it Sunrise Bowl (out of bounds), as Whistler's Blackcomb Home Run stretches outside the boundary keep their run's name.

Sunrise Bowl's out-of-bounds side, the outline (area=yes) that OpenStreetMap names Sunrise Bowl (Out of Bounds): Sun Valley's 2026-27 Bald Mountain trail map (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/maps-guides, 2627_SV_Baldy_Map_26-27_2580X1456.pdf) draws the ski area boundary between the in-bounds Sunrise Bowl and this slope south of it, and the resort's report lists no such run. OSM's Bald Mountain polygon reaches over it and it carries no backcountry tag, so the half rule would keep it in bounds; it is put out of bounds and named Sunrise Bowl, so the style labels it Sunrise Bowl (out of bounds), as Whistler's Blackcomb Home Run stretches outside the boundary keep their run's name.

A stale name: Sun Valley's 2026-27 Bald Mountain trail map (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/maps-guides, 2627_SV_Baldy_Map_26-27_2580X1456.pdf) labels the gondola from River Run Plaza to the Roundhouse ROUNDHOUSE EXPRESS GONDOLA and its mountain report (sunvalley.com/the-mountain/mountain-report) lists it as Roundhouse Express (Gondola); OSM still calls it Roundhouse Gondola.

A ski-jump piece (71 m, freeride in OSM) on the hill north-east of Sun Valley Village, 1.9 km north of Dollar Mountain's polygon beside a historic lift station building (way/1361277863, historic=yes): not Bald Mountain's or Dollar Mountain's terrain, on neither of the resort's 2026-27 maps nor its mountain report. It lies in no landuse=winter_sports polygon, so it cannot be listed as a neighbour, and would otherwise draw as a double-black run inside the box's north edge.
